entities.summary: Jitendranath Goswami is an Indian scientist from Jorhat, Assam. He was the chief scientist of Chandrayaan-1, and was also the developer of this project. He served as a director of Physical Research Laboratory situated at Ahmadabad, Gujarat. He was also associated with Chandrayaan-2 and Mangalyaan. Jitendra Nath Goswami was a scientists & inventors from Jorhat (b. 1950-11-18, Jorhat). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
